Houston, if you missed Chloe Radcliffe’s new Comedy Central special, *Eyes Down Here*, this is your chance to see her live.

Her stand-up is candid and sharp, built around dating, self-image, and the awkward stuff most people keep to themselves. She also brought *CHEAT*, her one-woman show about infidelity, to a sold-out month at the Edinburgh Fringe. I’d go for the precise jokes and honest stories that land a little too close to home.

Punch Line Houston · Wednesday, December 16, 2026

Houston, Gabby Bryan just released her crowd-work special, *Gabby Bryan Is My Therapist*.

Her shows are built on real talks with the room: dating, baggage, body image, and the strange work of being an adult. She filmed the special at a sold-out Nashville Comedy Festival show. If you like comedy that can only happen live, I’d go see @gabbyisbryan in person.

Houston, if you know DeRay Davis from Netflix’s *How to Act Black*, you know he doesn’t waste a setup.

Chicago-raised, sharp, and uncensored, DeRay brings stories about relationships, the business, and the world as he sees it. You may know him from *Wild ’N Out*, *Snowfall*, or hosting *Hip Hop Squares*. Live is where those observations hit different.

Houston Improv · Thursday, December 17, 2026

Houston, Sophie Buddle did stand-up on *The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon*, and she’s coming to The Riot.

Her Crave special, *Sophie Buddle: Smile, Baby*, is a good way in. Better yet, see her live. She’s low-key and ideas-based, moving through dating, tech, family, and politics without making a big show of it. If you like comics who let the premise do the work, this is a good night to bring a friend.

The Riot Comedy Club · Friday, December 18, 2026
